purpose: A mega menu for a website: a full-width drop-down sheet of grouped links that the site header opens, with focus kept inside and Esc to close.
namedChanges: The words are not in the unit: "Build on MyJackfruit", the audiences, the apps, the use cases and the waiting-list line moved to the `groups` prop.
The bottom Close control emits `close('button')`; the source emitted `close('esc')` for it. `'esc'` is now only the Escape key.
A row with no `href` is plain text: no `<a>`, no tab stop, no hover change, the default cursor.
The cream ground and the pith tint are not in the unit; colour comes from `--site-block-*`.
Tailwind, `theme()` and `NuxtLink` are written out as scoped CSS and a `linkComponent` prop (a plain `<a href>` by default).
The overlay z-index is the `zIndex` prop (default 40, the value of `Z_PLANES.overlay` in utils/zPlanes.ts at the same commit); the import of that module is not kept.

The dialog and the nav have their own names: the dialog's `label` (default "Site menu") and the nav's `navLabel` (default "Main"). Dropped: a site screenshot-tool hook (the source's `data-menu-panel` attribute).
When mounted already open, it locks scroll and takes focus at mount; the source did so only when `open` changed.

A side column that holds two headed lists is a `MenuStack` (side by side from 640px, stacked from 1024px), and a group's `tone: "quiet"` draws the source's quieter links; the call to action and the sheet's wash take their own variables (`--site-block-cta*`, `--site-block-sheet-wash`).

host.replaces: the hard-coded BUILD, AUDIENCES, APPS and USE_CASES lists
